1 | PASS | `src/components/Auth.tsx` implements registration via `supabase.auth.signUp` with email/password and username.
2 | PASS | `src/components/Auth.tsx` implements login via `supabase.auth.signInWithPassword` with email/password.
3 | PASS | `src/app/page.tsx` implements logout via `supabase.auth.signOut` triggered by the Logout button.
4 | FAIL | `src/components/Canvas.tsx` has a stubbed `stopDrawing` that skips DB insert; strokes are not broadcast to other players.
5 | FAIL | `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` assigns drawing on round start but lacks logic to rotate the drawer role between turns.
6 | FAIL | `src/components/Canvas.tsx` receives `word` as a prop, but `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` does not implement logic to hide the word from guessers.
7 | PASS | `src/lib/words.ts` contains a list of simple, age-appropriate vocabulary words suitable for elementary students.
8 | PASS | `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` implements a chat interface with real-time message insertion and display for guesses.
9 | FAIL | `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` checks guesses locally but fails to update game state (end round) reliably for all players or update scores in DB.
10 | FAIL | `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` calls a non-existent RPC `increment_score` and does not persist scores to the `room_players` table.
11 | FAIL | `src/components/Canvas.tsx` does not save strokes to the database, so drawing activity is not broadcast to other players.
12 | FAIL | `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` has `startRound` and `endRound` functions but no UI or logic to trigger them automatically or display clear start/end states.
13 | PASS | `supabase_schema.sql` defines tables for profiles, room_players, and scores with RLS policies for durable storage.
14 | PASS | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` fetches and displays a list of public rooms from the `game_rooms` table.
15 | PASS | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` displays room name, `current_players`, and `max_players` for each room in the lobby.
16 | PASS | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` allows joining rooms via `joinRoom` function, checking capacity before allowing entry.
17 | FAIL | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` listens for room changes but does not listen for `room_players` changes, so lobby doesn't update player counts in real-time.
18 | PASS | `src/components/Lobby.tsx` disables join button and shows "Full/In Progress" when status is not 'waiting' or capacity is reached.
19 | FAIL | `src/components/Canvas.tsx` does not save strokes to the database, so drawing order and timing are not persisted for replay.
20 | FAIL | `src/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx` renders Replay component but `strokes` state is empty because Canvas doesn't save data to DB.
21 | PASS | `src/components/Replay.tsx` implements Play, Pause, and Restart buttons with corresponding state management.
22 | FAIL | `src/components/Replay.tsx` uses local `setInterval` for playback, which is not synchronized across players.
23 | FAIL | `src/components/Canvas.tsx` does not persist strokes to the database, so replay data is lost on page reload.

rubric.4: Application provides a real-time multiplayer drawing canvas that broadcasts drawing activity to all connected players without requiring page refreshes.
rubric.5: Application implements a turn-taking system that designates exactly one player as the drawing player while all other players act as guessers.
rubric.6: Application assigns a vocabulary word to the drawing player at the start of each turn and ensures that only that player can see the word.
rubric.7: Application ensures that all vocabulary words are drawn from an age-appropriate list suitable for elementary school students.
rubric.8: Application provides a live chat interface that allows players to submit guesses in real time.
rubric.9: Application automatically detects when a player’s guess matches the correct word and updates game state accordingly.
rubric.10: Application tracks and updates scores for each player based on correct guesses and defined scoring rules.
rubric.11: Application delivers real-time updates for drawing strokes, guesses, scores, and turn changes to all players without requiring page reloads.
rubric.12: Application implements clear game start and game end states so players understand when a match begins, progresses, and concludes.
rubric.13: Application persists all user accounts and player score data using durable database-backed storage.
rubric.14: Application provides a lobby view that lists all available public rooms.
rubric.15: Application displays for each public room in the lobby its name or identifier, the current number of players, and the maximum capacity.
rubric.16: Application allows users to select and join any public room that is not full.
rubric.17: Application updates lobby information in real time as players join rooms, leave rooms, or new rooms are created.
rubric.18: Application clearly indicates in the lobby when a room is full and when it is currently in progress.
rubric.19: Application records the drawing strokes for each round in a manner that preserves their exact order and timing.
rubric.20: Application allows players, after a round ends and the correct word has been revealed, to watch a replay of that round’s drawing.
rubric.21: Application provides replay playback controls, including at minimum play, pause, and restart.
rubric.22: Application ensures replays are synchronized for all players who choose to view them simultaneously.
rubric.23: Application persists or caches replay data for at least the duration of the game session so players can rewatch recent rounds.
